hero.title: About
hero.tagline: A creative passionate about graphic design, audiovisual production and communication, I love bringing ideas to life through visuals

journey.title: From computer science to digital creation
paragraphs: A 2nd year Digital Media & Internet Studies student, I'm a creative at heart, always seeking new ways to express ideas through design and visuals.
Currently interning at Phantasmagloria in digital creation and audiovisual production, I'm looking for an apprenticeship starting September 2026 to continue my 3rd year of BUT MMI studies.

It all started with Photoshop. That first encounter was a revelation: I discovered you could create worlds, tell stories, and convey emotions through images alone. Since then, I've been constantly exploring the infinite possibilities of graphic design and visual identity.

Illustrator and Figma naturally complemented this journey as additional ways to bring my creations to life and make them interactive. But it's primarily the visual and creative aspects that guide my work.

interests.title: What attracts me
paragraphs: I see myself evolving in three areas I'm passionate about: graphic design, audiovisual production and communication.

As a graphic designer, I'd love to work on visual identity projects, poster creation, print or digital materials. Designing visuals that make an impact and tell a story is what motivates me every day.

The audiovisual world also attracts me enormously. Working on film sets, whether as an assistant director, boom operator, set assistant or with the technical crew, would be an enriching experience that would let me discover the behind-the-scenes of audiovisual creation.

design.title: Design & Inspiration
design.content: I spend a lot of time exploring visual trends and studying the work of designers and art directors. Whether it's a movie poster, opening credits, an advertising campaign or a music video, every striking creation enriches my perspective and enhances my creative approach.

learning.title: Continuous Learning
learning.content: Design, audiovisual and communication are constantly evolving, and I love that. I'm always seeking new knowledge and technologies.
